propositions: A managed link created locally but never pushed to peer (due to direction-agnostic dedup collision on vendor_type) can have its inbound removal record applied at G5, incorrectly deleting a link the peer never carried.

The existing managed_refs monotonic mark proves LOCAL ownership but not peer synchronization; G4 outbound-ADD suppression covers only links re-emitted by the differ, leaving gaps when (vendor_type, target_key) dedup masks relation-scoped collisions.
Inbound removal records must be declined for managed-but-never-peer-confirmed links and logged, while removals of peer-confirmed links continue to converge relation-scoped.

Peer confirmation state must persist in .bridge_state as a durable record (including Jira linkId, direction, confirming pass_id) keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation), survives SNAPSHOT compaction, and is written on successful outbound link ADD and populated from authoritative snapshots.
